# Smelloff — product reference

ODORSTRIKE is a pocket fabric freshener for clothes, made by Smelloff in Hyderabad, India: a 50ml spray that traps and neutralizes sweat, food and smoke odor in the fabric instead of covering it with perfume, and leaves a light fresh scent. It goes on clothes, never on skin: it is not a body deodorant, not a perfume and not a room spray. It dries in 15–30 seconds and gives up to 8 hours of odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions.

- Co-founder: Vineeth Kumar Duggepogu

## Founder
- Smelloff was founded by Nikhil Patil (full name Jogdhande Nikhil Patil; NikhilxPatil on X and Instagram), who is self-taught and based in Hyderabad, India. His own page: https://smelloff.in/NikhilPatil

## Product
- Name: ODORSTRIKE Fabric Odor Remover Spray (ODORSTRIKE)
- Category: Fabric Freshener for Clothes (Pocket Fabric Odor Spray)
- Size: 50ml / 1.69 fl oz
- SKU: OS-001-50ML · MPN: SMLF-ODST-50
- Price: shown on https://smelloff.in/odorstrike
- Packs: 1, 2 or 5 bottles; bigger packs cost less per bottle
- Cash on Delivery: available across India, free on orders of 2 or more bottles; a single bottle pays a shipping and COD handling charge by pincode, shown at checkout
- Quantity per order: 1–10
- About 250 sprays per bottle (about 100 refreshes)

## How it works
- HPβCD (cyclodextrin) traps odor molecules, Zinc PCA neutralizes them and Triethyl Citrate helps prevent new odor forming, plus 8 supporting ingredients. Exact concentrations are proprietary.
- Trap: HPβCD
- Neutralize: Zinc PCA
- Prevent: Triethyl Citrate
- Sustained freshness: Zinc Gluconate
- Glycerine-free and fast-drying; light fresh fabric scent that fades. Not a perfume.

## How to use
- Distance: 15–20 cm
- Dry time: 15–30 seconds when sprayed as a fine mist from about 15cm. In high humidity or with heavier application, wait until the fabric is fully dry before wearing. Can take up to 30–60 seconds in high humidity.
- Doses: targeted 2–3 sprays; full shirt 4–5 sprays; jacket 5–6 sprays
- Protection: Up to 8 hours under normal office/commute conditions
- Fabrics: cotton, polyester, blends, denim, wool. Not for skin, hair, pets, leather, suede, shoes, bags, rooms, sofas or curtains. Patch-test silk, zari and heavy embroidery.

## Shipping and returns
- Free shipping pan-India on prepaid UPI / card / netbanking orders. Cash on Delivery is free on orders of 2 or more bottles. A single-bottle COD order pays a shipping charge and a COD handling charge based on the delivery pincode, shown at checkout before the order is placed. Prepaid orders ship free.
- Dispatch: Within 48 hours of confirmation (Monday–Saturday). COD orders are confirmed via phone call before dispatch.
- Delivery: metros 3–5 business days; tier 2/3 cities 5–7 business days; remote 7–10 business days. India only. Ships from Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
- Returns: 7-day return window from delivery. Bottle must be at least 80% full and in original packaging. Reverse pickup where serviceable. Refund within 5–7 business days.

## Approved claims
- Fabric freshener for clothes: a pocket fabric odor spray that neutralizes odor instead of covering it with perfume — not a perfume, not a body deodorant.
- Light fresh fabric scent — not a perfume. ODORSTRIKE is a fabric odor-control mist with a light, crisp fabric scent that provides sensory confirmation of clean fabric while targeting unwanted odor in the weave.
- Targets and traps sweat and environmental odor molecules at the clothing fabric weave.
- Up to 8 hours of odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions.
- Safe for regular use on everyday washable clothing fabrics (cotton, polyester, denim, blends, wool). Patch-test silk.
- Dries clear with no stiff residue when sprayed from recommended 15–20 cm distance.

## Not claimed
- It is not a skin deodorant, antiperspirant or perfume.
- It does not kill bacteria; no antimicrobial or medical claim is made.
- It does not replace washing and does not remove stains.
- It is not unscented: it has a light fabric scent that fades.
- Do not claim an instant or guaranteed cure, or a specific number of sprays per day.
- Real reviews only; no rating or review count is published until verified buyers leave them.
